items.followUp: Why does atomic radius generally decrease across a period from left to right?

rubric.why: Across a period, increasing nuclear charge attracts the electrons more strongly.
rubric.description: States that nuclear charge increases across the period.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that nuclear charge or proton number increases; award 0 otherwise.

rubric.why: The stronger attraction makes it harder for atoms to lose electrons, reducing electropositive character.
rubric.description: Explains the decrease in electropositive character through stronger attraction for electrons or greater difficulty losing them.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for linking increased attraction or harder electron loss to reduced electropositive character; award 0 otherwise.

modelAnswer: Across a period from left to right, nuclear charge increases.
The valence electrons are attracted more strongly, so atoms lose electrons less readily and electropositive character decreases.
